set.body: Scope: PRD Phases 8-10. Extract interop and enforce executable source-import and build-edge guards; remove archive/latent types from dataset core; normalize the manifest and canonical writer through factual versioned LNA adaptation and interrupted-publication evidence; then lock representation, persistence, dataset, locality, provenance, publication, registry, and numerical-regression laws. Close only when the dependency DAG is acyclic and mechanically enforced, LNA/canonical/unknown fixtures behave correctly, partial canonical writes never publish, every phase preserves the frozen numerical corpus, downstream scenarios remain green, no pre-release forwarding alias or historical response/archive name remains, and compileAll/testAll pass warning-clean on the exact committed tip.
set.title: EPIC RRA-D: module extraction, manifest normalization, and release laws
